description: This file contains functions for integrating WooCommerce with ERPNext, including request verification, order processing, customer and address management, item linking, and sales order creation.

methods.name: verify_request
methods.description: Verifies the webhook request signature using HMAC and base64 encoding.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Main entry point for processing WooCommerce orders, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: _order
methods.description: Internal function to process the order data, create or update customer info, and generate sales orders.

methods.name: link_customer_and_address
methods.description: Links or creates customer and address records based on WooCommerce order data.

methods.name: create_contact
methods.description: Creates a contact record linked to a customer.

methods.name: create_address
methods.description: Creates an address record for a customer.

methods.name: rename_address
methods.description: Renames an address record based on customer name and address type.

methods.name: link_items
methods.description: Links or creates item records based on WooCommerce line items.

methods.name: create_sales_order
methods.description: Creates and submits a sales order in ERPNext based on WooCommerce order data.

methods.name: set_items_in_sales_order
methods.description: Adds items and tax details to the sales order.

methods.name: add_tax_details
methods.description: Adds tax details to a sales order.
